The page computes nothing: the cells of every table equal served strings; the only number drawn that the page did not receive as a string is the array length of `receipt_ids`; no total row, share, recipient count or denominator — verify: property test (every cell string appears in the input) and e2e DOM comparison against the fixture.
A null value in `totals` shows "Unknown", never 0, `0.00` or a dash; a null `period` or `currency` hides that part with no gap — verify: unit test and e2e on a variant.

Authority comes from the server only: `/work/4712` (`can_publish:false`) shows no Publish for any job title in the mock session, and no code path reads a role or job title — verify: grep `frontend/src/features/finance/business-units` for role and job-title strings returns nothing.

Wrong person: a 403 on Publish or on the receipt shows "You can't do this." plus the server message and re-reads, no retry; a `csrf_failed` 403 refreshes the session once, says "Press again" and sends no second request — verify: e2e scenarios `forbidden` and `csrf`; unit test counts fetches.

Wrong tenant or unknown record: a 404 on the read or on either write shows exactly "This record is unavailable."; a 403 on the read looks the same; nothing distinguishes them — verify: e2e compares text and DOM structure.
Invalid input: a 422 shows the server message and `fields[]` as given and re-reads — verify: scenario `invalid`.
Stale publish: a 409 re-reads, shows the server message, does not repeat the press; the next press carries the new `expected_revision` — verify: e2e scenario `stale` with capture of both bodies.
Second receipt: a 409 `already` re-reads, shows the server message and the page shows "You confirmed receipt." when the re-read has `receipt_id`; no repeat send — verify: e2e scenario `already`.

Uncertain publish: a dropped connection after Publish locks the button, says "We couldn't confirm that this happened. Check the page before trying again.", sends nothing by itself for 60 s of fake time, and unlocks only when the re-read has a changed `expected_revision` or a non-null `publication_id` — verify: unit test with fake timers; e2e scenario `drop` counts POSTs.
Uncertain receipt: same for the receipt; unlocks only after the re-read shows `receipt_id` non-null (control gone) or after a reload; never auto-resends — verify: unit test and e2e scenario `drop`.
A 429 or 503 says "Try again shortly." and sends nothing more by itself — verify: unit test over 30 s of fake time.

A null `expected_revision` or `case_revision` disables Publish with "We don't have this item's current version yet. Reload and try again." and sends nothing; a null `publication_id` hides the receipt control — verify: unit test on both descriptors.

risk.rationale: High: publishing sends payroll-derived money aggregates to people outside Finance (the CEO and BU heads). A wrong recipient, a premature publish or a small-group leak cannot be undone, and a double publish or double receipt is an uncertain effect. Surfaces are ui and api (`business-units` publish and `aggregate-receipt`), security and auth (per-recipient views with server-decided authority), external-messaging (delivery to the CEO and BU heads), and product-decision (D-187 chose to build on the API's disclosure, and PSL can still overrule D-PAYROLL-VISIBILITY). Files: `frontend/src/features/finance/business-units/` (from F-107). Payments is not ticked because nothing is invoiced, paid or posted.
